text:
maria: FYI external pen-test (CrimsonSec) starts Tue 2026-06-02 09:00 PT. Need staging ops + evidence plan.

jamal: noted. scope still same? staging + read-only logs + auth flows?

maria: yes — staging, read-only copies of auth/audit logs, KMS proxy enabled, no real keys. assessor gets ephemeral role `pt-assessor` with S3 upload and CloudWatch read.

alex: recommend these RBAC rules:
- role: pt-assessor
- policies: ReadCloudWatch, ReadS3:arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-evidence-staging/*
- deny: kms:Decrypt for production keys

toni: can we record APM traces? we want request/response sampling plus prefix KV cache traces for suspect flows.

jamal: APM sampling = 5% by default; for PT we can bump to 25% for 48h via `TRACE_SAMPLE_RATE=0.25` in staging deploy. Be careful with costs.

maria: agree. Also we need audit log retention export to S3 daily; SIEM tag `pt:external` added to all events. Can infra flip that quickly?

kevin: yes — I can add tagger lambda and forward to Splunk. Need the exact keys for the staging bucket and presigned policy.

maria: use bucket `redwood-pt-evidence-staging`. Upload command for assessors:
```
aws s3 cp findings.json s3://redwood-pt-evidence-staging/Assessors/CrimsonSec/ --acl bucket-owner-full-control \n  --profile pt-assessor
```
And presigned URL helper (expiry 2h):
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-pt-evidence-staging/Assessors/CrimsonSec/findings.json --expires-in 7200
```

jamal: For KMS, we'll provide a mock key `alias/pt-staging-kms` that allows Encrypt only; Decrypt denied. We'll run a proxy that mints ephemeral wrapping keys for assessor uploads.

maria: doc snippet for RBAC window:
- Access window: Tue 09:00–11:00 PT (2h)
- Emergency extension: +1h via @oncall approval
- Evidence upload deadline: Tue 13:00 PT

deploy-bot: ticket created PT-4829 for assessor access and staging bucket perms :clipboard:

incident-bot: reminder scheduled 2026-06-02T08:45:00Z — pre-test checklist run

alex: small ask — can we avoid logging full prompt payloads? mask PII and full prompt bodies for compliance. We'll set masking via `PROMPT_MASK_LEVEL=partial`.

toni: QA: can we snapshot role bindings and persistent audit exports before access window? Need that for retest proof.

kevin: I'll run `aws iam generate-credential-report` and store in `s3://redwood-pt-evidence-staging/ops-reports/cred-report.csv` before 08:50PT.

maria: remediation flow: put vuln ticket in PT-Remediate board; triage label + severity. Assign owner then 7-day SLA to fix or schedule rollback. Retest slots available Fri/Sat next week 10:00–12:00 PT.

jamal: For retest coordination — please include steps to reproduce, logs snapshot id, and the exact commit/tag we rolled out to prod/staging.

maria: action items:
- kevin: create bucket + presign policy (due EOD today)
- alex: set `PROMPT_MASK_LEVEL` and bump trace sampling (due EOD today)
- jamal: create pt-assessor role and attach policies (due EOD today)
- toni: prepare test prompts and repro guide for assessors (due Mon)

kevin: on it. I'll post the presigned URL template here once ready.

alex: I will add masking and a flag to redact logs at ingestion. Will post snippet.

toni: prepping repro guide now. linking tracker when ready.

maria: thanks everyone. we'll do a dry-run Monday 16:00 PT with CrimsonSec contacts to validate uploads and role swaps.

kevin: Confirmed for dry-run. :thumbsup:

maria: closing loop — please add any blockers by EOD. otherwise we go green for test plan.
